_about: Hand-curated segments where the boxer is working TOWARD the camera, i.e. the camera stands where the opponent would be. Selection criterion is gaze/punch direction, NOT shoulder-line squareness -- selecting on squareness would produce a set with no bladed boxers in it. Times are SOURCE-VIDEO seconds; index the blazepose caches via the cache's _pts.npy (searchsorted), never actual_start + i/fps. See spans_from_rows() in roll_duck_experiment.py.
_schema: stem -> [ {label, round, start_sec, end_sec} ]. start_sec null = from the beginning (of the round when `round` is set, else of the video); end_sec null = runs to the end. `round` binds a span to one cache round and MUST be set whenever start_sec is null and the video has several rounds, otherwise the span leaks into every round. Optional `clip_window: [a, b]` pins which slice make_clips.py cuts for the coach reel instead of sampling one at random -- it does NOT narrow the span used for analysis. Stems match video_wh.json exactly (beware double spaces in titles).
